questions.prompt: I would rather die than serve a cruel tyrant.
questions.answer: mālim morī quam crūdēlī tyrannō servīre.

questions.prompt: I would not want you to think that I am joking.
questions.answer: nōlim putēs mē jocārī.

questions.prompt: I wish you would heed the warnings of the old men.
questions.answer: velim veterum monita audiās.

questions.prompt: One might say that the whole affair was a lie.
questions.answer: dīxerit aliquis tōtam rem mendācium fuisse.

questions.prompt: Someone may object that our plans are useless.
questions.answer: dīcat aliquis cōnsilia nostra inertia esse.

questions.prompt: I should call that man happy who conquered his own excess.
questions.answer: beātum illum dīxerim quī suam intemperantiam vīcerit.

questions.prompt: I would rather stay silent than tell a lie.
questions.answer: mālim tacēre quam mendācium dīcere.

questions.prompt: You would think the sudden storm was threatening the whole city.
questions.answer: putēs subitam tempestātem tōtī urbī imminēre.

questions.prompt: I wish you would sit in this splendid chair.
questions.answer: velim in hāc splendidā sellā sedeās.

questions.prompt: Someone might follow the footprints left in the snow.
questions.answer: sequātur aliquis vestīgia in nive relicta.

questions.prompt: One would more quickly find Fortune than keep her.
questions.answer: fortūnam citius reperiās quam retineās.

questions.prompt: I wish you would spare the conquered enemies.
questions.answer: velim victīs hostibus parcās.

questions.prompt: Someone may say that idleness ruined our ancestors.
questions.answer: dīcat aliquis ignāviam majōrēs nostrōs perdidisse.

questions.prompt: I would rather obey my uncle than my father.
questions.answer: mālim patruō quam patrī pārēre.

questions.prompt: You would call nothing more shameful than a broken pledge.
questions.answer: nihil turpius dīxeris quam fidem violātam.

questions.prompt: I should believe that these fears are groundless.
questions.answer: hōs metūs vānōs esse crēdiderim.

questions.prompt: I wish you would come more often to our gatherings.
questions.answer: velim ad conventūs nostrōs saepius veniās.

questions.prompt: Someone might unroll the ancient books hidden in the temple.
questions.answer: revolvat aliquis veterēs librōs in templō occultātōs.

questions.prompt: Someone might say that the ancient temples still stand.
questions.answer: Dīcat aliquis templa antīqua adhūc stāre.

questions.prompt: I would readily believe that the general had concealed his true purpose.
questions.answer: Facile crēdiderim ducem vērum prōpositum cēlāvisse.

questions.prompt: I wish you would forgive the young men who fled from the battle.
questions.answer: Velim iuvenibus ignōscās quī ex proeliō fūgērunt.
